<function name="GetDecimals" parent="DProperty_Float" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called to poll the amount of digits after the decimal point. This is used internally for <page>DProperty_Int</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="data" type="table">The amount of digits after the decimal point.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
